accessibility.$description: I-08B3.1-F1 accessibility expression, DARK appearance. DELIBERATELY THIN. Every accessibility transformation F1 makes is either a re-route along the frozen reading ramp or a change to a value that d2-world's PRESENTATION_CONTRACT already declares `encodes: null`. Neither kind needs a new literal, and F1 introduces none. The LIGHT appearance of every one of these is owned by I-08B3.1-F2 and does not exist yet; the resolver fails loudly rather than returning a colour nobody designed.

com.qandeel.provenance.note: Compare I-08B3.1-E1, which added exactly one colour and said so. F1 adds none, and that is not modesty — it is the consequence of the law that an accessibility setting changes representation only. A transformation that needed a new colour would be describing a thing the default cannot express, which would make it a design change wearing an accessibility name.

atmosphere.$description: The ambient field's derived expression values, dark appearance. These are the ONLY numbers F1 authors that reach a painted pixel, and every one of them lands on a property PRESENTATION_CONTRACT declares meaningless.

lightness-near.$description: Default. Inherited byte-for-byte from I-08B3.1-D2R's qandeel.atmosphere.luminance.near. Present so that the increased-contrast override has something to override BY NAME rather than by patching a scene constant.

com.qandeel.freeze.why: the DEFAULT, inherited byte-for-byte from I-08B3.1-D2R. It is present so the increased-contrast override has a name to override rather than a scene constant to patch; the value itself is D2R’s and is not F1’s to freeze.

stroke-alpha-multiplier.$description: Default. The field is drawn at D2R's own per-world stroke alphas, untouched.

com.qandeel.freeze.why: the DEFAULT sentinel: the field is drawn at D2R’s own per-world stroke alphas, untouched.
